buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. Technical & Licensing Requirements 1.1 The bidder shall supply 100% genuine, authentic and legally licensed software from the res pective software developer or authorised distributor. 1.2 All software must be the latest available stable version, wherever applicable, and shall be c ompatible with the existing computer hardware and operating environment of the Unit. 1.3 Office 2021 Professional shall include the complete professional office productivity suite wit h essential applications for word processing, spreadsheets, presentations and other standard office functio ns. 1.4 Operating System software shall be Windows 11 Professional, Version 25H2, 64-bit, with a genuine and valid activation licence. 1.5 Designing Software shall provide essential tools for graphic designing, image editing, layou t preparation, creative artwork and designing of official documents, charts, banners and instructional/traini ng materials. 1.6 Protective Software shall provide comprehensive protection against viruses, malware, ranso mware, spyware, phishing and other cyber threats, with a minimum validity of one year from the date of s uccessful activation. 2. Licence & Activation Conditions 2.1 The bidder shall clearly mention the software name, edition, version, licence type and licen ce validity in the technical bid. 2.2 All software licences must be genuine, verifiable and legally transferable or assignable to t he purchaser, wherever permitted under the manufacturer's licensing policy. 2.3 OEM-authorised activation keys/licence credentials shall be provided along with the softwar e. 2.4 The licences supplied must not be trial versions, evaluation versions, educational versions or unauthorised volume-licensing keys. 2.5 Each software licence shall be activated successfully on the designated computer system(s ) of the Unit. 2.6 The bidder shall provide appropriate licence certificates, activation details, product keys an d proof of authenticity wherever applicable. 3. Installation & Technical Support:- 3.1 The successful bidder shall be responsible for installation, configuration and successful acti vation of all software on the designated computer systems. 3.2 Necessary installation files, setup packages and official download links shall be provided w herever applicable. All license should be delivered in OEM’s CD/DVD (Paper license) with Physical Key 3.3 The bidder shall provide technical assistance for installation, activation and troubleshooting without any additional charges during the applicable warranty/subscription period. 3.4 Any software found defective, counterfeit, unauthorised or incapable of successful activatio n shall be replaced immediately by genuine and functional software without additional cost to the purchas er. 4. General Conditions

4.1 The bidder shall ensure that all supplied software complies with applicable copyright laws, l icensing agreements and cybersecurity requirements. 4.2 The bidder shall not supply any pirated, cracked, modified or unauthorised software. 4.3 The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of software licences directly thro ugh the respective software manufacturer or authorised channel. 4.4 Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory delivery, installation, activation and verification of all software by the authorised representative of the Unit. 4.5 Any discrepancy in the supplied software, licence validity, edition or technical specifications shall render the supply liable for rejection. 4.6 The purchaser reserves the right to reject any software that does not meet the prescribed t echnical requirements or is found unsuitable for the intended official purpose. 5. Documents to be submitted by the Bidder:- The bidder shall submit the following documents al ong with the technical bid: 5.1 Manufacturer's Authorisation Certificate (MAF), wherever applicable. 5.2 Proof of authorised dealership/reseller status, wherever applicable. 5.3 Technical brochure/product datasheet of each software. 5.4 Declaration regarding genuineness and authenticity of software licences. 5.5 Declaration that the supplied software is not pirated, counterfeit or trial-based. 5.6 Undertaking regarding successful installation and activation on site. 5.7 Details of warranty, subscription validity and technical support. 5.8 GST registration certificate, PAN details, Aadhar Card, NEFT Certificate, Udyam Registration Certificate and Cancelled Cheque. 5.9 The purchaser reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids without assigning any re ason There of, and the decision of the purchaser shall be final and binding on all bidders. 5.10 The bid shall be submitted strictly in accordance with the terms & conditions and technical s pecifications prescribed in the bid document. Any deviation, conditional bid, or non-compliance shall be tre ated as non-responsive and shall be rejected without further consideration. 5.11 Any item found defective, damaged, short-supplied, or not conforming to the bid specificati ons shall be replaced by the bidder at its own cost within the time specified by the purchaser. 5.12 The bidder shall submit a declaration confirming no history of unsatisfactory performance or contract termination in any Government contract in the last three (03) years 5.13 The bidder shall confirm the availability of adequate resources, infrastructure, and capacity to execute the order quantity within the specified timeline. 5.14 Only the documents uploaded at the time of bid submission shall be considered for evaluati on. Any clarification, replacement, or additional document submitted after bid submission shall not be considered. 5.15 The bidder shall upload a signed and stamped copy of the complete tender document as a t oken of acceptance of all terms and conditions. 5.16 The bidder shall supply only new, unused, and unused-in-service products. Refurbished, rec ycled, old, or reconditioned items shall not be accepted. An undertaking in this regard is to be submitted a long with the bid.

5.17 The bidder shall submit a self-declaration regarding compliance with Rule 144(xi) of GFR relating to restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a country which shares a land border with I ndia. .
